prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
A subdued cartographic map of Aurora Berg, rendered as an archival chart
on warm-cream parchment. The Aurora Stack crystalline spire colony
sketched on one tier of the Berg, Nightshelf tunnel labyrinths
crosshatched beneath, the Corpse Current marked as a dark arc of warm
water tracking below the sea-ice. Compass rose in one corner. Faint
hex-grid overlaying the landmass. Echo-script annotations in the margins.
Muted enough that white text overlaid on it stays fully legible — this
is a backdrop, not a feature. Antique atlas aesthetic, civilizationally
aware.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor archival cartographic plate of a polar berg rendered on warm vellum parchment, crystalline spire colony sketched in fine nib linework above crosshatched tunnel labyrinths, a dark thermal current arcing below sea-ice, muted slate and aged cream holding the composition at documentary remove

subjects.description: Aurora Berg rendered as antique atlas chart — tiered crystalline spire colony in fine linework at the summit, Nightshelf labyrinths crosshatched in dense parallel strokes below, faint hex-grid overlay across the landmass, echo-script margin annotations in a Chinese-influenced hand
Dark thermal warm-water current marked as a bold curved cartographic line beneath the sea-ice shelf, labeled in archival script, faint warm watercolor wash bleeding along its course
subjects.position: lower third, sweeping left to right

subjects.description: Ornate 19th-century expedition compass rose, foxed parchment border with faint age staining, restrained decorative frame in aged ink
